1.

Sweet it is to be with Thee, Lord, in Thy Father’s house, Where Thou already among the angel throng Dost reign in heaven’s light. Soon Thou wilt come to lead us Home to Thee and make us blessed. O what joy it shall be! O what joy it shall be!

2.

What no ear has heard, What no mortal eye has seen, What no human heart has found, God has prepared for His own. The Spirit makes it clear to us, And to faith He reveals it, What in Christ is given to us. What in Christ is given to us.

3.

By grace a pilgrim throng, Strangers we wander here; But soon with Thee we shall be, See Thee, Jesus, as Thou art. Thou dost appear before God for us, While the Spirit here leads us Homeward to our fatherland. Homeward to our fatherland.

4.

Soon, O Lord, Thou wilt come, Lead us into the home, Where with all Thy godly ones, We shall behold Thy glory And with glad and free tongue Ever sing praise and honour To Thee, who hast so loved us. To Thee, who hast so loved us.
